info.title: ZOAURO Admin API
info.description: Generated from the shared Zod schemas (apps/api/src/openapi/operations.ts). Do not edit by hand.

sessionCookie.name: zo_sid
sessionCookie.description: Opaque session id in an HTTP-only, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie (doc 14, doc 52)

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Required on every state-changing request: the session-bound token with the session cookie, or before sign-in the token from GET /auth/csrf (equal to the zo_csrf cookie)

preSessionCsrfCookie.name: zo_csrf
preSessionCsrfCookie.description: Pre-session CSRF cookie set by GET /auth/csrf (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict); double submit with X-CSRF-Token

get.summary: This OpenAPI document
Pre-session CSRF token: sets the zo_csrf cookie and returns the same token for X-CSRF-Token on login, password reset and 2-step POSTs
